snapshot.label: Luggage
snapshot.text: Main bags stay at hotels in Cusco and Puno — pack a daypack for Aguas Calientes (Sept 20–21) and the Lake Titicaca homestay (Sept 24).

altitude.text: Sea level in Lima → Cusco 3,450 m (Sept 19) → Lake Titicaca 3,800 m (Sept 23–24). Go slow, hydrate, ask a doctor about altitude meds.

reservations.note: Peru's top-ranked cocktail bar; small plates too.

reservations.name: Maido
reservations.address: Maido, Calle San Martín 399, Miraflores, Lima
reservations.note: Mitsuharu Tsumura's Nikkei tasting menu; reconfirm day before, flag dietary needs, smart-casual.

farewell.title: Have the best trip
farewell.text: Eleven days, four altitudes, one very cold night on a reed island. Michael & Laura, Sept 2026.
